PAPA FEEL Retinol Anti Aging Face Moisture Cream

For these skin troubles:
▪Dark spots & pigmentation

▪Dull yellow skin

▪Sagging & fine lines
▪Rough skin & big pores

How to use
After cleansing, drop 2-3 drops on face, massage gently until absorbed."
